charts.title: From every entry that mentions a conjecture down to the one line that failed.
charts.takeaway: 1,179 of 23,883 entries (4.9 percent) had a line the parser accepts; 213 lines from a random 500 were tested and 1 failed.

steps.label: 23,883 entries mention a conjecture
steps.detail: Counted in the public OEIS data repository.

steps.label: 1,179 have a parsable line
steps.detail: 4.9 percent. The parser accepts an equation in n and earlier terms with integer coefficients, so the result describes simple linear recurrences.

steps.label: 500 entries drawn at random
steps.detail: Seeded draw. They held 531 conjecture lines, and 512 parsed.

steps.label: 213 lines tested
steps.detail: Tested means the b-file (the entry's long list of terms) runs at least 30 indices past the entry's data section. Median reach: 967 terms past it.

steps.label: 212 of 212 planted errors caught
steps.detail: Each passing equation had its first integer coefficient raised by one and was run again.

steps.label: Wrong-entry equations pass at 0.005
steps.detail: Each equation applied to another entry's terms, 200 draws of 30. This is the chance level of the test.

steps.label: 1 line failed: A031740
steps.detail: Held for 64 indices, failed at n = 65. The entry has recorded the conjecture as false since 2016.

charts.title: Share of tested conjecture lines that failed on their own b-file.
charts.takeaway: 1 of 213 lines failed, 0.47 percent (interval 0.08 to 2.6), below the forecast of 4 percent; the interval spans the 1 percent rule.
charts.units: percent of tested lines whose equation is false at some index of the b-file; lower means fewer wrong conjectures
charts.n: 213 tested conjecture lines from 500 sampled entries
charts.interval: 95 percent Wilson interval (a range for a share that stays valid when the count is small)
charts.baseline: Forecast written before the run: 4 percent
charts.threshold: Failure rate above 1 percent, set in advance; not met, since the rate is 0.47 percent
charts.ruled_out: A failure rate above 2.6 percent among simple linear recurrence conjectures of this kind (upper end of the interval)

axis.label: percent of tested lines that failed (lower is fewer wrong conjectures)

charts.title: Can the check tell a right equation from a wrong one?
charts.takeaway: Real lines pass at 0.995 and every planted error is caught, while equations run on another entry's terms pass at 0.005: the check separates right from wrong.
charts.n: 213 tested lines; 212 planted versions of the passing lines; 200 control draws of 30 equations
charts.interval: Whisker on the control row: 5th to 95th percentile of the draws. The other two rows are single counts.
charts.baseline: Cross-entry control: each equation applied to a different, randomly chosen entry's terms
charts.threshold: Planted errors caught at least 0.99; real pass rate above the control's 95th percentile (0.033)

rows.label: Real lines that pass on their own b-file
